title: Tanzania's Geography in Brief
excerpt: From Kilimanjaro to Lake Tanganyika and the Indian Ocean: a short introduction to Tanzania's geography.
body:
## Size

Tanzania covers roughly 945,000 km², making it the largest country in East Africa.

## Neighbours

Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DR Congo, Zambia, Malawi and Mozambique.

## Highest and lowest

- Highest: Kilimanjaro, 5,895 m.
- Lowest: the floor of Lake Tanganyika, one of the deepest lakes in the world.

## Lakes

Lake Victoria, Lake Tanganyika and Lake Nyasa (Malawi) border Tanzania.

## Rift Valley

Branches of the Great Rift Valley cross the country, with lakes such as Manyara and Natron.

## Coast and islands

About 1,400 km of coastline, plus Zanzibar, Pemba and Mafia.

## Capital

Dodoma is the official capital; Dar es Salaam is the largest city.

See our [Tanzania facts page](/tanzania-facts-and-useful-tips/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
